id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

children.description: Components to render in the body of the modal container.

closeWithStackedModal.description:
Correspond to SDLModal config.

True if the modal should be closed when a stacked modal on top of it is closed.
The application should only allow stacked modals if the second modal is a
confirmation (or something similar in nature).

size.description: The preset size of the modal.

open.description: The open state of the modal.

header.description:
Correspond to SDLModalBody config.

Text to be rendered in the header section.

subHeader.description: Text to be rendered in the header section beneath the header.

showTopDivider.description: Whether the modal should render a divider above content.

showBottomDivider.description: Whether the modal should render a divider below content.

content.description:
String content to be rendered in the body of the modal.
Note that if the translation value contains dynamic variables,
e.g. "Hello {name}", do not wrap the translation key with
'{~' and '~}'

modalType.description: Button layout configuration on the modal.

disablePrimaryButton.description: Whether or not to disable the Primary Button.

disableSecondaryButton.description: Whether or not to disable the Secondary Button.

disableTertiaryButton.description: Whether or not to disable the Tertiary Button.

isLoadingPrimaryButton.description: Whether or not to set primary button to loading (spinner).

isLoadingSecondaryButton.description: Whether or not to set secondary button to loading (spinner).

isLoadingTertiaryButton.description: Whether or not to set tertiary button to loading (spinner).

primaryButtonClickDebounce.description:
Ms to debounce clicks on primary button.
Defaulted to 300ms.

secondaryButtonClickDebounce.description:
Ms to debounce clicks on secondary button.
Defaulted to 300ms.

tertiaryButtonClickDebounce.description:
Ms to debounce clicks on tertiary button.
Defaulted to 300ms.

uiDataGridComponentId.description: Component id of the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} which spawned the event modal.
